newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says 1997 budget trends satisfying.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says 1997 budget trends satisfying.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday that the trends in the 1997 budget were satisfying.
He told a news conference that the latest figures for April confirmed a trend shown in March, which showed the deficit at some 20 billion francs less than at the same time last year.
"I confirm that the trends are satisfying," Arthuis said.
He also reiterated that economic growth would be better this year than the 2.3 percent officially forecast.
"We will be above 2.3 percent," he said.
He also welcomed industrial production figures for March released earlier which showed a rise in manufacturing output of 0.4 percent from the previous month.
"There has been a significant rise over the whole of the quarter," he said. "I think it is a very good piece of news and we should welcome it."
